messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to push kernel v2.8.1 + new quant profile (q8-fast) to prod next Wed. Target window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Can owners ack and confirm smoke / rollback readiness?

liam: ack from infra side. I can own the deploy step and monitor slot health. Do we have a fallback model build if quant causes perf regression?

chen: what are the exact smoke checks? I can run them from the canary slice during the window.

maya: good q. minimal smoke checklist: 1) weave throughput test (1k reqs/min) 2) end-to-end latency p95 < 250ms for short prompts 3) kv cache hit parity sanity 4) no OOMs in 30m of load. Will paste quick commands below.

maya: smoke commands:
```
# throughput
ab --concurrency=50 --num=1000 https://canary.internal.redwood/api/generate
# latency sample
python tools/latency_probe.py --model=canary-slot --n=200
```

sam: we should ping model-onboarding and runtime-kernel-owner in the PR for last review. PR is at: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/3912

olivia: I can run the KV cache comparison harness and a small prompt-quality eval during the canary. Will post results in this thread.

liam: rollback plan: if perf reg hits or >1% error rate, we flip the routing flag back to v2.7 and redeploy old kernel. Steps: 1) disable new quant routing 2) scale up previous runtime build to absorb traffic 3) revert image tag in deployment. I have a runbook.

maya: runbook link: https://confluence.internal.redwood/runbooks/quant-rollback (short checklist in PR as well).

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Reserved deploy window for eng-runtime on 2111112222 02:00-04:00 UTC. Reminder: attach canary logs to release artifact.

chen: quick question on telemetry — will the new profile emit per-kernel op counts? need that to triage if the kernel hot path regresses.

maya: yes, v2.8.1 adds kernel-op counters behind `telemetry.kernel_ops=true`. We'll enable that for the canary only.

sam: pinging @runtime-kernel-owner and @model-onboard: please glance at the canary PR today. If no major comments by EOD PST, we proceed.

olivia: I'll post the KV and small eval by 21:00 UTC tonight.

liam: also adding a quick smoke test script to CI that runs on the canary slice before we flip traffic. snippet I'm going to use: 
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
./tools/warm_kv.sh --slot canary
python tools/latency_probe.py --model canary-slot --n 100
curl -sS https://canary.internal.redwood/api/health || exit 1
```

maya: perfect. last ask — who's on pager if we need rollback? liam?

liam: I'll be on primary. olivia secondary for quality checks, chen for infra issues.

deploy-bot: :information_source: Reminder: please set `canary=true` and `telemetry.kernel_ops=true` in the release metadata before kick.

maya: thanks all — if no objections by EOD PST today I'll mark the PR green and we go ahead with the Wed window. :thumbsup:
